title: SC06-T2 — the reveal (SH05)
line: It has jojoba, shea, vitamin E, so it feels like nothing and never cakes. It covers the lines, the tired, the circles, and it still looks like your own skin.
motionPlan: the brush end works the white stripe on Michelle's cheekbone in small circles; behind the brush the white warms into her own olive shade, ahead of it still white; every line stays

ingredients.label: PROD-HAND-CARD
ingredients.note: held low, a little longer than her hand is wide

ingredients.label: COLOUR-FRONT-CARD
ingredients.note: white ahead of the brush, her shade behind; lines unchanged

note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
